name: Retardo Audiovisual
description: Detecta retardos audiovisuales anómalos que indican manipulación de video
mechanism:
This method detects audio-visual temporal misalignment to identify deepfakes, following Chugh et al. (2020):

1. **Labio Movimiento Extracción**: Lip landmark positions are tracked per frame, computing lip aperture (vertical opening), lip spread (horizontal width), and lip area. The temporal signal of these geometric features captures the visual component of speech articulation.

2. **Audio Envelope Extracción**: The speech audio amplitude envelope and energy contour are computed in corresponding time windows. Additionally, voice activity detection (VAD) segments identify speech vs. silence boundaries in the audio stream.

3. **Cross - Correlación Análisis**: The temporal cross-correlation between lip motion signals and audio energy is computed at multiple lag values. Authentic speech shows peak correlation at near-zero lag (within the natural audio-visual asynchrony tolerance of ~±50ms). Deepfakes may exhibit shifted peaks due to imprecise lip-sync in face-swap or lip-sync models.

4. **Fonema - Level Synchrony Check**: Specific phonemes with visually distinctive mouth shapes (visemes) — bilabials /p/, /b/, /m/ requiring lip closure, and open vowels /a/, /o/ requiring wide opening — are detected in audio and verified against corresponding visual frames. Temporal mismatches at these critical phonemes indicate manipulation per Mittal et al. (2020).

5. **Dynamic Synchronization Puntuación**: The consistency of audio-visual synchrony is measured over time. Natural speech maintains stable synchrony throughout. Deepfake videos may show variable synchrony — good alignment in some segments but drifting in others — as the face generation model intermittently fails to track the audio signal accurately.
parameters:
Tipo de análisis: sensor
Medio: video
Entrada: Video frames extracted at key intervals
Salida: Puntuación de confianza (0-100)
Frame sampling: Adaptive (1-5 fps depending on method)
Temporal window: Sliding window across frame sequence
accuracy: Moderada a Alta — 70-88% precisión independiente. Most effective when combined with other video forensic methods. Performance depends on video quality, resolution, and compression level.
source: Video forensics and deepfake detection research. Based on computer vision and temporal signal analysis methods.
useCase: Detección de deepfake y video generado por IA mediante audio-visual delay analysis. Este método examina características temporales y espaciales que son difíciles de replicar perfectamente por sistemas de IA, proporcionando evidencia para la evaluación de autenticidad del video.
strengths:
• Captura artefactos temporales que el análisis de cuadro único pierde
• Funciona con formatos de video estándar
• Efectivo contra técnicas comunes de deepfake
• Se puede combinar con otros métodos forenses de video
• Basado en investigación establecida de visión por computadora
limitations:
• Rendimiento afectado por la compresión y resolución del video
• Algunos métodos requieren suficiente cantidad de cuadros para el análisis temporal
• La efectividad varía según la técnica de generación de deepfake
• Se usa mejor como parte de un pipeline integral de múltiples métodos
• Puede producir falsos positivos en videos auténticos con edición intensiva

references.title: Chugh, K. et al. (2020). Not Made for Each Other — Audio-Visual Dissonance-based Deepfake Detection. ACM MM.
Mittal, T. et al. (2020). Emotions Don't Lie: An Audio-Visual Deepfake Detection Method Using Affective Cues. ACM MM.
